findings.label: Register post-success route ignores role
findings.detail: safeReturnUrl defaults to /home, so the register component always navigates to /home regardless of the user's role. The backend hardcodes CLIENT on the register endpoint so this is not a real user-facing bug today, but the criterion requires role-aware navigation on registration success. The login component handles this split correctly; the same pattern is missing in register.component.ts. Possible concern — confirm whether any code path can create an ADMIN through the register endpoint.

findings.label: Interceptor 401 exclusion is too narrow
findings.detail: The auth interceptor excludes only /auth/login from the sessionExpired path. /auth/register is not excluded. A 401 from the register endpoint would set sessionExpired=true and redirect to the login page, losing the user's in-progress registration. The backend currently returns 409 for duplicate email and never 401 from register, so this is not triggered in practice. Widening the exclusion to /auth/ would be safer.
